Came here to upgrade my car audio system on a dodge challenger. The sound went out a few weeks after I had service done. I brought it back to get it re-checked and they fixed whatever the issues was. Few weeks pass and the sound goes out again. I call them and they say to bring it back , but they’ll need the car all day. I drop off the car , take Ubers to and from to work back to this place and they had not even gotten to my car despite it being there for 8 + hours . They said they didn’t have enough time and to come back another day. Not to mention , all my audio settings were messed up .

I had enough and brought it to another audio shop and they said this was probably the worst job they’ve ever seen. Do not go here. I spent $4k here and still had to come back numerous times.

I went to their office in July and spoke to Andrew and another staff member and they said they would get back to me with a quote. In person they seemed helpful and ready to help me fix my car stereo and camera.

I sent many several follow up emails to get the job going and they kept saying they would send me a quote but they never did. It’s been 3 months and still nothing from them. If they didn’t want to do the job they could’ve just said no, instead they’ve just wasted my time with no apology or explanation.
